purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) electronic claim file creation in CSV format for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system
purpose.summary: ORCR0300 creates electronic receipt (レセプト) claim data files in CSV format for Japanese medical insurance billing. It reads multiple indexed receipt detail files (RECE02–RECE11) and writes formatted claim records including diagnosis, procedures, medications, and insurance information. The program handles various special cases such as public expense billing, elderly patient co-payments, and regional public health insurance rules.

notable_features: 389 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Multiple INDEXED files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
No COMP-3 usage (uses standard numeric PIC)
Long lines (up to 116 chars) but predominantly fixed format
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Latin-1 decoded); Japanese comments appear garbled in the excerpt but are structurally intact. File is 6194 lines and ~288KB, a substantial production program. Truncated at 16000 chars; full DATA and PROCEDURE divisions not visible but structure is clear from indicators.
